Load and Haul Superintendent, Kolwezi, DRC – M/F

Context:

Gladys Synergies is recruiting on behalf of an international mining company operating in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

The company is seeking an experienced Load and Haul Superintendent to reorganise, strengthen and improve its loading and hauling operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving daily production performance, optimising equipment utilisation, managing operational teams and coordinating mining contractors to ensure safe, efficient and cost-effective operations.

This position plays a critical role in achieving production targets, improving fleet performance, establishing effective dispatching and ensuring a consistent supply of material to support processing operations.
